name.km: ចៀនទឹកត្រីក្ដាម

description: Fried crisp, then tossed in a sticky caramelised fish-sauce glaze.
descriptionKm: ចៀនទឹកត្រី — លាបទឹកត្រី និងស្ករត្នោត។
equipmentKm: ខ្ទះ ឬ ម៉ាសុីនចៀន

ingredients.notesKm: សម្អាត ហើយកាត់ជា ៤

ingredients.itemKm: ប្រេងសម្រាប់ចៀន

ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.text: Prepare the crab: cleaned and quartered.
instructions.textKm: រៀបចំក្ដាម៖ សម្អាត ហើយកាត់ជា ៤។

instructions.text: Heat oil to 170°C. Fry the crab until the shells turn bright orange and crisp.
instructions.tip: Fry in small batches so the oil stays hot and the crust stays crisp.

instructions.text: Toss the fried pieces in the caramel until glazed; finish with chili and spring onion.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។
